book.name: Galesia
book.title: Galesia Pâlaŋ Zisas Kilaisiyelen am maŋge Galesia msalen mamamtemien ekŋengat zapat meluwaŋ kapi kumindaye

content: Zii zet gawepupu ma nâmkiŋpepeyelen zet
Wakae, Galesia am seoŋ maŋge penaŋ! In am pe kwiyaŋ keŋin mme kilom beye? Neŋ Zisas Kilais tewen kumasasokpepeŋaŋ keyet yaŋaŋ weyaŋ zemâtâtindama nâmbien.
In zii zetgalen mama mimi ke mâpmamti Kawawaŋgalen Emetak Teŋ ke tiwien? Ma Kawawaŋgalen Zet Zapat Dolakŋaŋ Penaŋ kapi nâmti nâmkiŋpemti Kawawaŋgalen Emetak Teŋ tiwien ze? Olak zeme nâmbi!
In ke kwilekiyet seoŋ penaŋ beme delaŋ zemâzin? In Kawawaŋgalen Emetak Teŋgalen selen yaŋbemti mebienaŋ naman itnaŋaŋ ke ewe gilik zemti ilinaŋgalen windeen mdelaŋ zesâgât tapmip ma?
In Kawawaŋgalen Emetak Teŋmak kot tusume kwitnaŋ kwitnaŋ nukŋaŋ inmagen sokbemindamâge ke in nâme belak penaŋ sokbemindaye kegok bein?
Ma in zii zet mâti mamaip keyepmti Kawawaŋaŋ Emetak Teŋaŋ indamti menok inmagen mammsokbein? Yek, in Kawawaŋgalen Zet Zapat Dolakŋaŋ Penaŋ nâmti manâmkiŋpeip keyepmti menok mamip.
Kawawaŋgalen Zet Itnaŋaŋ keyaŋ Abalaamgat pigok zenzeŋaŋaŋ tazin,

content.text: “Abalaamaŋ Kawawaŋgat nâmkiŋpeyeyepmti Kawawaŋaŋ egat nâme an teŋ beye.” (Sokbembe 15:6)

content: Keyepmti in pigok penaŋ nâit, am nâmkiŋpepemak mamaip ekŋenaŋ Abalaamgat nemunambaŋaŋ penaŋ bemti mamaip.

Am Zuda maŋgeen ku sokbembeŋaŋ ekŋenaŋ eyo nâmkiŋpepe aikme Kawawaŋaŋ indikme an imbi teŋ bembeyet zenzeŋaŋ keyepmti eweŋan Kawawaŋaŋ Abalaamgat zet zapatnaŋ kapi zeme Kawawaŋgalen Zet Itnaŋanen pigok kumpewien,

content.text: “Abalaam, geŋ nâmkiŋpepemak bewanan keyepmti geŋmagengatnaŋ alikdi sokbewe. Âpme am msat sambe ekŋenaŋ ek nâmkiŋpemti set keeset kaisasatnaŋ ke mâti mme neŋ ekŋen aŋgalaŋindewap.” (Sokbembe 12:3; 18:18; 22:18)

content: Keyepmti am Kawawaŋ manâmkiŋpeip ekŋenaŋ Abalaamak tusume Kawawaŋaŋ nsakwep tewalaŋ sambe mandamkwatain.
Âpme am notnaŋ zii zelaŋ ŋeŋaŋ bemindeme mamaip ekŋen Kawawaŋaŋ saik makumindein keyepmti Kawawaŋgalen Zet Itnaŋaŋ kapigok mimiŋaŋ tazin,

content.text: “Zii zelen zet sambe tazin ke ŋep ku kululuyelen. Am ŋenaŋ kwep ŋen makuluin beme ek Kawawaŋaŋ saik makumpein.” (Zii Zet 27:26)

content: Keyepmti an ŋenaŋ zii zet keyet keŋan mamti naman neŋ Kawawaŋgat zikatnan teŋ penaŋ yompiŋ mayap. Kegok ŋep ku zenzeyelen elak Kawawaŋgalen zet piyaŋ sosok penaŋ pigok zemkawaŋ beme nânup,

content.text: “Nâmkiŋpepeen etaŋ Kawawaŋaŋ indikme teŋ mambeip am ekŋen keyaŋ etaŋ mama kanzizit aikbep.” (Habakuk 2:4)

content: Zii zetgat keŋanen nâmkiŋpepeyet zetnaŋ ŋen ku zenzeŋaŋ Kawawaŋgalen Zet Itnaŋaŋ pigok gulak zenzeŋaŋ,

content.text: “An ŋenaŋ zii zet sambe ke mâti mamambe beme maneti keyet penaŋaŋ mama kanzizit tiwe.” (Wok Pris 18:5)

content: Âpme Kawawaŋgalen Zet Itnaŋanen zet ŋen kapigok tazin,

content.text: “Am tewen maindom masasokindeip ekŋen Kawawaŋaŋ saik makumindein.” (Zii Zet 21:23)

content: Âpme Zisas ek yomepiŋ yaŋgut egaŋ am yominmak Kawawaŋaŋ saik kum indeme nukŋaŋ matip sepem kegogak tiye. Kegok timti am zii zetgalen zemdelaŋ zenze muluwengatnan gilik zemndatiye.

Zisas Kilaisiyelen zet gawepupu ma gakikiŋaŋ pembenaŋgapmti Kawawaŋaŋ Abalaam Emetak Teŋ sasayet zetik mpeye ke am Zuda maŋgeen ku sokbembeŋaŋ ekŋenaŋ ke time delaŋ zeye. Âpme nin nâmkiŋpepemak bemtiŋgut Emetak Teŋ titiyet Kawawaŋ ikŋaŋ eweŋan zapatnaŋ zemndendeŋaŋ ke ŋep tiwanup.
Zii zet keyaŋ Kawawaŋgalen zetik mge ke ŋep ku asekbe

Nâmkiŋpepeen notnne, neŋ kwitnaŋ kwitnaŋ masokbeme eknâminup keeset zet ŋen pigok bem zema nâit: an zut ŋenaŋ keŋ kwep bemti muluwit kwileki ŋen mimiyet zemkatik bemalu an ŋenaŋ ku maasekidein ma an ŋenaŋ nânâ ŋen ku matusumidain.

Kawawaŋaŋ Abalaamak iŋsokŋane sambe ekŋenmagengatnan an kwep ŋenmagen kwitnaŋ kwitnaŋ dolakŋaŋ bam sokbembeyet zetik mpeye. Kawawaŋgalen Zet Itnaŋanen muluwaŋ ke wa iŋsokŋane sambe ekŋengat meluwaŋ mimiŋaŋaŋ ku mamaiŋ nânup: Iŋsokŋane sambe, ekŋengat tuŋguwinaŋgatnaŋ sokŋaŋ kwewetaŋ egat zet zapatnaŋ mimiŋaŋaŋ mamaiŋnup sokŋaŋ ke Kilais.

Kawawaŋaŋ Abalaamak zemtâmti tâtâ ke mkatikŋaŋ beye ma zetik mge ke ŋep ku asesekgalen. Kegok mti mamkwatnepeme nup kan 430 bemeŋgut zii zet 10 ke Moses saye. Keyepmti zii zet keyaŋ Kawawaŋaŋ Abalaamak tâtâ mti kwitnaŋ kwitnaŋ ke sokbembeyet zetik mpeye ke ŋep ku asekbe.

Zii zet ekŋen kapi weyaŋ gawepumann delaŋ zeme keyaŋ yomengatnan gilik zemti ndatiti set ke tadak ze nin naman zetik mimiŋaŋ keyet kataŋ ku mbenek. Âpme Kawawaŋaŋ keŋ taoletnaŋgat Abalaam zetik mpeye keyet penaŋ saye.

Âpme naman yaŋaŋ eneyet penaŋ Kawawaŋaŋ zii zet kapi beye? Kawawaŋaŋ am ekŋenaŋ yommnaŋgat yaŋaŋ ekmâtâtâtgat nâmti zii zet kapi indaye. Zii zet ke mti manepeme zetik mimiŋaŋ keyet penaŋaŋ Kilaisiyaŋ am mamain sokbeme zii zet kapi delaŋ zenzeyet zenzeŋaŋ. Kukŋaŋgat Kawawaŋaŋ zii zet ke ensel ŋengat betnan beme egaŋ mti Kawawaŋ ma am ekŋengat an tuŋguwin Moses egat betnan beye. Beme Mosesiyaŋ mti kot yeŋsokŋine ekŋen indamti zemâtâtindaye.
Âpme kukŋaŋgat Kawawaŋaŋ Abalaamgat zetik mpeyeen egaŋ igak etaŋ zeye. An ŋenaŋ tuŋgupman tatat ke yek penaŋ, ensel ma Moses mee kogak yek.
Zii zelaŋ gapmukulem mti Kilaismagen ku gaikmebe

Keyepmti in nâme zii zet alakgatnaŋ zeya keyaŋ Kawawaŋaŋ eweŋan zetik mge ke ŋep peŋpeme mebe bein? E ŋep ku mimiyelen. Kawawaŋaŋ zii zet kapieset amnaŋ mama titiyet set aikndaye ze amnaŋ zet keeset etaŋ mepme Kawawaŋaŋ indikme teŋ beme mama ŋep maaik indamanak.

Yaŋgut Kawawaŋgalen Zet Itnaŋaŋ nin pigok zikat ndain: Msalen am sambe bepi yom mimiyet tikŋaŋin omba penaŋ matazin. Keyepmti an ŋenaŋ Zisas Kilais nâmkiŋpewe beme Kawawaŋaŋ Emetak Teŋaŋ ke taolet ndandayet zetik mge ke sawe.
Nin eweŋan nâmkiŋpepeyelen setnaŋ ewe sokbemndandapiŋ tapme zii zet katikŋaŋ kandaŋan tatnepemann nâmkiŋpepeyet zetik mimiŋaŋ keyet penaŋaŋ sokbemkawaŋ bem ndaye.
Zii zelaŋ ndamusuweti mandalem kwatnepeme Kilaisiyaŋ ikŋaŋ kopme ek nâmkiŋpemti Kawawaŋgat zikatnan yompiŋ teŋ bembeyet kegok mimiŋaŋ.
Kilaisiyaŋ kopme nin egat nâmkiŋpemti keyet sakŋan gwaenen nin zii zetgat kandaŋan ŋen ewe ku matatnup.
Nâmkiŋpepeen nin Kawawaŋgat nenunambaŋane mambenup
In Kilais Zisas nâmkiŋpewiengapmti in Kawawaŋgat nembaŋaŋ bemti mamaip.
In Kilaismak tususu mme tu zulutindeme Kilais ikŋaŋ nemboŋak bewien.
Kegok mti am sambe Zuda ma am Zuda maŋgeen ku sokbembeŋaŋ ma sisiliŋ nemba ma am belak lala mamaip ma an ma imbi nin sambe Kilaismak tusumti am maŋge kwep kwabien.
In Kilaisiyet zapat bewien kan keyet in Abalaamgat iŋsokŋane penaŋ bewien. Mti eweŋan Kawawaŋaŋ Abalaamgat zetik mpeye keyet penaŋaŋ Emetak Teŋ timti mamaip.
